cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 202, destination Harbin. You just departed from Beijing airport at 23. You are passing 1200 meters and want to climb to 1800 meters, contact Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 202，目的地哈尔滨。你 23 从北京机场刚起飞，正通过 1200 米，想爬升至 1800 米，联系北京离场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN6202, from Beijing to Harbin, airborne 23, passing 1200 meters, request climb to 1800 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN6202，从北京飞往哈尔滨，23 离地，通过 1200 米，请求爬升至 1800 米。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 202, Beijing Departure, radar contact, due to slower preceding traffic, cancel SID, turn right heading 010.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，北京离场，雷达识别，因前机速度较慢，取消 SID，右转航向 010。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn right heading 010, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，右转航向 010，CSN6202。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 202, climb to 5400 meters on standard, resume own navigation, direct to Yankee Victor, via flight planned route.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，标准气压爬升至 5400 米，恢复自主导航，直飞 Yankee Victor，按飞行计划航路。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 5400 meters on standard, resume own navigation, direct to YV via flight planned route, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 标准气压爬升至 5400 米，恢复自主导航，直飞 YV，按飞行计划航路，CSN6202。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that your weather radar shows a build-up around Yankee Victor, request direct to KAKAT.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告知管制员你的气象雷达显示 Yankee Victor 附近有云团发展，请求直飞 KAKAT。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN6202, our weather radar shows a build-up around YV, request direct to KAKAT.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN6202，我们的气象雷达显示 YV 附近有云团发展，请求直飞 KAKAT。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 202, contact Beijing Control 125.9 for request.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，请联系北京管制125.9 提出请求。

cards.audioText: B: Make an initial contact with Beijing Control, 5400 meters maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due to weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：与北京管制首次联系，保持 5400 米，因天气请求直飞 KAKAT。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, 5400 meters maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN6202，保持 5400 米，因天气请求直飞 KAKAT。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, climb to and maintain 10700 meters due Air Force restriction, suggest heading 020.
B: Because the CB is 2 large, you want heading 030.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，因空军限制，爬升并保持 10700 米，建议航向 020。
B：由于 CB 太大，你想航向 030。
cards.referenceText: Climb to maintaining 10700 meters, request heading 030 due CB, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 10700 米，因 CB 请求航向 030，CSN6202。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 202, turn right heading 030 approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，同意右转航向 030。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 030，CSN6202。

cards.audioText: B: Now, you have clear weather, back on course.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已脱离天气，回到航路。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, cleared weather, back on course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN6202，脱离天气，回到航路。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, Beijing roger.
B: Tell the controller that you are getting an ice build-up as a result of suspected de-icing equipment failure, request descent below freezing level.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，北京收到。
B：告诉管制员，疑似除冰设备故障导致结冰积聚，请求下降到冰点高度以下。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, possible de-icing equipment failure, ice is building up, request descent below freezing level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN6202，可能除冰设备故障，正在积冰，请求下降到冰点高度以下。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, roger, descend to 6300 meters, report when require lower, do emergency conditions exist?
B: Tell the controller this level should be sufficient and emergency conditions do not exist.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，收到，下降至 6300 米，需要更低高度时报告，是否存在紧急情况？
B：告诉管制员该高度应足够，且不存在紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 6300 meters, it should be low enough and no emergency conditions exists, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6300 米，应该足够低，没有紧急情况，CSN6202。

cards.audioText: B: There may be a problem about flight control system, request return to Beijing airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：飞控系统可能有问题，请求返回北京机场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, possible problem with flight control system, request return to Beijing airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN6202，飞控系统可能有问题，请求返回北京机场。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, roger, confirm approach and landing normal?
B: Say no problem.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，收到，确认进近和着陆正常？
B：回答没问题。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，CSN6202。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 202, turn right direct to GITUM, descend to and maintain 3600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，右转直飞 GITUM，下降并保持 3600 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to GITUM, descend to and maintain 3600 meters, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 GITUM，下降并保持 3600 米，CSN6202。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 202, contact Approach 120.6.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，联系进近 120.6。

cards.audioText: B: Descend to 3600 meters, contact Approach, tell him you have a further problem with your leading edge flap extension and believe it is because of the prior icing issue.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降至 3600 米，联系进近，告诉他前缘襟翼伸展又有问题，并认为这是先前结冰问题造成的。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN6202, descend to 3600 meters, we have a further problem with our leading edge flap extension, possibly due to earlier icing issues.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN6202，下降至 3600 米，我们的前缘襟翼伸展又有问题，可能由于先前结冰问题。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, Beijing Approach, roger, do you require any other assistance?
B: Tell Approach you have a micro-switch malfunction and will conduct a flapless landing and request runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，北京进近，收到，你需要其他协助吗？
B：告诉进近你有微动开关故障，将执行无襟翼着陆，并请求跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN6202, we have a micro-switch malfunction and will conduct a flapless landing and request runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN6202，我们有微动开关故障，将执行无襟翼着陆，请求跑道 36R。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 202, roger, change of runway 36R, turn left heading 090, descend to and maintain 2700 meters on QNH 1013, information Charlie.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，改用跑道 36R，左转航向 090，QNH 1013 下降并保持 2700 米，通播 Charlie。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, turn left heading 090, descend to and maintain 2700 meters on QNH 1013, information C, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，左转航向 090，QNH 1013 下降并保持 2700 米，通播 C，CSN6202。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 202, turn right heading 270, descend to 1800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，右转航向 270，下降至 1800 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 270, descend to 1800 meters, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 270，下降至 1800 米，CSN6202。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 202, the field is 11 miles away, report visual contact.
B: Tell the Approach, you have the runway in sight.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 202，机场距你 11 海里，报告目视。
B：告诉进近你看到跑道。
cards.referenceText: We have the field and runway in sight, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们看到机场和跑道，CSN6202。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 202, make visual approach 36 right, turn final when ready.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 202，执行目视进近 36R，准备好时转五边。
cards.referenceText: Make visual approach 36R, turn final when ready, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行目视进近 36R，准备好时转五边，CSN6202。
